newsitem.title: UK: PVC MIllenium Dome is safe -UK govt.
newsitem.headline: PVC MIllenium Dome is safe -UK govt.

text.p: The British government on Monday rejected the environmental concerns of Greenpeace and insisted that a PVC-covered Millennium Dome would be safe.
The environmental pressure group said the covering planned for the grandiose project marking the turn of the century was "a toxic, plastic, throwaway monster." It promised to stage protests.
But Peter Mandelson, the minister in charge of the project, said: "The clear conclusion, on the basis of objective scientific evidence, is that PVC is the safest and strongest option."
The dome, dogged by controversy over its funding, is to be erected at Greenwich, the London suburb on the banks of the River Thames which is the site of the meridian marking zero degrees longitude.
